protocol.io: local filesystem reads after fixture creation; OS cache not flushed; not cold I/O
protocol.scheduler: CooperativeWork 2 ms target, explicit Node setImmediate task yields; not browser or default Node timer latency
protocol.timing: preparation and CPU surface constructor only; fixture synthesis, GC and fingerprints excluded; onSlice memory instrumentation included in wall time
protocol.memory: exact typed-array/texture-format accounting plus process checkpoints; checkpoints are not continuous peaks; driver/JS overhead excluded from format accounting
protocol.graphics: no WebGL context; texture bytes are format accounting, not measured GPU time/VRAM; no planar/snapshot/caustics/terrain-renderer budget included

diagnosticTransforms.needle: if ((options.landform === "island" || options.landform === "coast") && options.size !== "small") throw new Error("Island/Coast currently supports Small worlds only (Ocean terrain budget)");
